name: enterprise
comment: The bundle as shipped: --enable-all, all quantum crypto, old TLS, secure renegotiation, HPKE, AES-CTS/GCM-SIV, acert, TSP, S/MIME, OPENSSL_COMPATIBLE_DEFAULTS and the system crypto-policy reader.

name: enterprise-no-all-osp
comment: Without the OSP bundles nothing else turns 3DES back on, so this is the only entry where the bundle's --disable-des3 takes effect.

name: enterprise-no-oldtls
comment: --disable-oldtls has to suppress the TLS 1.0 default the bundle would otherwise set, or TLS 1.0 pulls old TLS back on.

name: enterprise-renegotiation-indication
comment: Mutually exclusive with secure renegotiation; the bundle must not set both.

name: enterprise-asn-original
comment: Attribute certificates and TSP are only handled by the ASN.1 template code, so the bundle must leave both off here. Build only: --enable-all-quantum-crypto with --enable-asn=original fails PQ private-key decoding tests in make check independently of the enterprise bundle.

name: enterprise-no-openssl-compatible-defaults
comment: Feature set without the OpenSSL run-time behaviour defaults.
